# awscc_ec2_i_pv_4_pool (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::EC2::IPv4Pool. A public IPv4 pool is an EC2 IP address pool required for the public IPv4 CIDRs that you own and bring to AWS to manage with IPAM (BYOIP).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) Any tags assigned to the public IPv4 pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the public IPv4 pool.
- `description` (String) A description of the public IPv4 pool.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `network_border_group` (String) The name of the location from which the address pool is advertised.
- `pool_id` (String) The ID of the public IPv4 pool.
- `total_address_count` (Number) The total number of addresses in the pool.
- `total_available_address_count` (Number) The total number of available addresses in the pool.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_i_pv_4_pool.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the public IPv4 pool

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_i_pv_4_pool.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_ec2_i_pv_4_pool.example "arn"
```
